The JS and WASM artifacts were already present in this repository's initial
commit `369592c`. The inherited README identified Basis Universal and Apache-2.0
but did not record their exact upstream source/build revision. The license-text
commit above pins the added notice; it does not assert that the inherited
artifacts were compiled from that revision. No binary was downloaded, rebuilt,
or changed as part of this attribution update. The original file hashes are
retained so a later source/build provenance investigation can identify them.
